name: Workspace File Guard
description: Keep test, temp, scratch, log and cache files inside the current workspace or PI scratch. Works on any machine: Windows, macOS, Linux, any drive letter, any username.

en.name: Workspace File Guard
en.description: Keep test, temp, scratch, log and cache files inside the current workspace or PI scratch. Never spill onto the system volume, Desktop, Downloads, Documents or system temp.
en.safetyNotes: Behavioral confinement only. The plugin classifies paths and injects agent rules; it does not lock disks, change ACLs, or access the network.

zh-CN.name: 工作区文件护栏
zh-CN.description: 把测试、临时、草稿、日志、缓存等垃圾文件关在当前工作区或 PI scratch 里。任意机器、任意盘符、任意用户名都可用，不写死 C: 或本机路径。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 这是行为约束，不是磁盘锁。插件只分类路径并注入 Agent 规则，不改 ACL、不联网。

author: xingleiwu

agentTools.name: project_root
agentTools.description: Resolve the open PI-Desktop workspace, PI scratch directory, and recommended .tmp layout. Fails if no workspace is open and root is omitted.

agentTools.name: check_path
agentTools.description: Classify whether a write path is allowed. Read allowed, not ok. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace, not the plugin process cwd. allowed=false must be redirected into the workspace or PI scratch.

explicit.description: Set true only when the user clearly named this destination

agentTools.name: temp_env
agentTools.description: Return TMP/TEMP/cache environment assignments that keep tool junk inside the project .tmp and PI scratch.

shell.description: Script dialect for the env assignments. Defaults to PowerShell on Windows and bash elsewhere.

agentTools.name: tmp_layout
agentTools.description: Return the recommended $project/.tmp/{tests,scripts,cache,out} layout without creating files.

changelog: 0.2.4：说明改为中文。0.2.3：去掉 git/cwd 作为项目根回退；cmd 环境变量拒绝内嵌引号；覆盖工作区 API 失败与 explicit 临时目录拒绝。0.2.2：相对路径相对工作区解析。0.2.1：explicit 目标与 XDG_DOWNLOAD_DIR。0.2.0：跨机器便携。
safetyNotes: Behavioral confinement only. The plugin classifies paths and injects agent rules; it does not lock disks, change ACLs, or access the network.
